title: UD Quon Custom Built FUPS HI-tensile Aluminium Bullbar #1
description: UD Quon GW25470 hi-tensile FUPS aluminium Bullbar. heavy duty contoured channel to suit driving, plus fog and indicator lights. Main cross tubes are one piece 76mm tube through drilled uprights and recessed into the outer uprights. Tow pin and heavy duty steel backing plate. Driving light mounts can be fitted to customer requirements.
